name: Ledger
description: Double-entry books: a journal entry block and a bank-statement CSV importer (the two write surfaces), plus a set-up-books command that seeds a starter chart of accounts.
author: OpenBook

blocks.description: Every account's balance, asserted to sum to zero
One account's postings with a running balance
Turn a bank CSV into draft entries, without doubling anything up
Match an account against a bank statement, down to a 0.00 difference
Assets, liabilities and equity as at a date
Revenue less expenses over a period, with net income
Close the books for a date range and lock it
Download the books as a Beancount journal, verified
